name: Memoriant Ops Bot Skill
description: Multi-provider AI agent remote control for Claude Code. Manage Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Gemini CLI agents from Telegram or Matrix. Send commands, check status, monitor health, and manage sessions from your phone. Includes full working bot (published on PyPI as memoriant-ops-bot v0.15.1).
longDescription:
Ships **4 skills** and **2 agents**.

- **Skills** (4): `check-status`, `manage-agents`, `manage-sessions`, `send-remote-command`
- **Agents** (2): `ops-coordinator-agent`, `task-dispatcher-agent`

Installs with `claude plugin install memoriant-ops-bot-skill@claude-community` from `NathanMaine/memoriant-ops-bot-skill`.

A Claude Code plugin for managing remote AI agents via MOPS (Memoriant Ops Bot System). Control Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, and Google Gemini CLI from any device through Telegram or Matrix. Multi-provider, multi-session, background tasks, and agent health monitoring.
